violation_definition: The carrying path is in violation when, within the horizon, either (a) its smoothed RTT exceeds 150 ms — the control-class deadline — or (b) its windowed loss exceeds 3.0 %, or (c) it becomes unusable. Identical definition is used for the heuristic, the learned model and the offline labels.
notes: Split by whole run and by scenario family, never by row.
Labels are computed offline from the recorded run; features are the observations the controller had at decision time.
Rows where the carrying path was already in violation are excluded.
The test seed block was not touched by this script.
